alignments.note: The projection carries the imperative reading selected for WLC.PRO.13.20.v001; the ASV's *Walk* answers to it. The marginal *He that walketh with wise men shall be wise* records the other reading and is set aside under rule 38.
H854 *with*, an ordinary preposition under rule 16's closing sentence.
Substantival adjective completed by a supplied generic *men*; the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme under rule 31.
Conjunction of the selected reading for WLC.PRO.13.20.v002, rendered *and*.
Imperative of the selected reading, rendered with its subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17 and headed on the predicate adjective.
Anarthrous substantival participle with the supplied *the* of rule 46.
Rectum takes the chain's *of* under rule 19.
Niphal verb with its auxiliary; the Hebrew gloss *be broken* corroborates the source reading and decides nothing.

The Hebrew verb is intransitive and writes no object; the supplied preposition and the pronoun it stands before answer to no morpheme, stand together and do one office, so they are one added unit under rules 2 and 44. Reading *for* as part of the English verb's own rendering was the alternative.

review_notes: Both variant units were resolved to r01 in the projection and their tokens are aligned as ordinary source text.
